title: verify_session 200 response (SPEC.md §14.3)
description: Non-200 statuses are normative behavior, not body schemas: 401/403 refuse the stream with the same status (optional body {"reason": string}); anything else refuses with 503.

principal.description: Any JSON value. Stored verbatim for the session and echoed byte-identical on every subsequent webhook call (§12.13). The service never inspects it.
